<!--
  The top bar of DashboardShell: the brand (when no sidebar carries it), the links (when there is no sidebar),
  an optional search field, and the signed-in person.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { ShellNav } from "../blocks/dashboard-shell.types";

  export type ShellTopbarProps = {
    nav: ShellNav;
    brand?: "show" | "hide";
    links?: "show" | "hide";
    search?: "show" | "hide";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import MenuEntry from "../components/menu-entry.svelte";
  import NavBlock from "../components/nav-block.svelte";
  import SearchPalette from "../components/search-palette.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl, uniqLabel } from "../utils";

  let { nav, brand = "show", links = "hide", search = "show", landmarkLabel }: ShellTopbarProps = $props();
</script>

<Block
  tag="header"
  class="flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center gap-6 border-b border-border bg-background px-6"
  data-testid="topbar"
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
>
  {#if ((brand as string) === "show")}
    <Group gap="2" align="center" class="shrink-0" data-testid="brand">
      <LucideIcon name="layers" size={24} />
      <Text size="base" weight="bold" class={(true ? "" : "sr-only")}>
        {nav.brand}
      </Text>
    </Group>
  {/if}
  {#if (((links as string) === "show") && ((nav.links?.length ?? 0) > 0))}
    <NavBlock
      label={(landmarkLabel ? uniqLabel(tpl("{0}, {1}", nav.label, landmarkLabel)) : nav.label)}
      class="hidden lg:block"
    >
      <List class="m-0 flex list-none items-center gap-2 p-0">
        {#each nav.links as l (l.id)}
          <ListItem>
            <MenuEntry
              href={l.href}
              class={cn(
                "flex items-center gap-4 rounded py-2 text-sm",
                (true ? "px-4" : "justify-center px-2"),
                ((l.id === nav.current) ? "bg-muted font-medium" : "")
              )}
              current={(l.id === nav.current)}
              size="sm"
              testid="item"
            >
              <LucideIcon name={l.icon} size={16} />
              <Inline class={(true ? "" : "sr-only")}>
                {l.name}
              </Inline>
            </MenuEntry>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    </NavBlock>
  {/if}
  {#if ((search as string) === "show")}
    {#if ((links as string) === "show")}
      <Box class="ml-auto hidden w-64 shrink-0 xl:block">
        <SearchPalette label={nav.search} shortcut={nav.shortcut} />
      </Box>
    {:else}
      <SearchPalette label={nav.search} shortcut={nav.shortcut} />
    {/if}
  {/if}
  <Group
    gap="4"
    align="center"
    class={
      ((links as string) === "show") && ((search as string) === "show") ? "shrink-0"
      : "ml-auto shrink-0"
    }
    data-testid="user"
  >
    <LucideIcon name="bell" size={20} class="text-muted-foreground" />
    <MediaFrame alt={nav.userName} ratio="1/1" class="size-8 shrink-0 rounded-full" />
  </Group>
</Block>
